messages:
anya (prod): quick take — we need a pragmatic way to decide whether to sequence Dedicated work before Private. customers asking for isolation + compliance, but capacity revenue is urgent. thoughts?
leo (eng): can we frame as two axis: upstream revenue / bookings impact vs engineering effort + infra risk?
mike (ml): +1. also model-serving complexity differs — Private needs packaging + network assumptions, Dedicated is more about pooling and autoscale config.
sarah (sales): from field: two enterprise pilots this quarter explicitly require VPC. they'd convert at ARR if we ship. one is willing to sign an MSA.
anya (prod): that sounds like high impact but high effort. can we run a quick RICE-ish table to make the tradeoff visible? not full docs, just a one-slide score.
leo (eng): i sketched an initial RICE in prod channel earlier — will paste gist. feel free to poke.
leo (eng): ```
Feature                Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort  RICE
Dedicated capacity     40     3       0.8         3       32
Private (VPC/on-prem)  10     5       0.7         8       8.75
```
anya (prod): nice. That highlights Dedicated as better ROE short-term. but the confidence for private is low because of unknown infra work.
mike (ml): we should add a quality/regression cost for private — different networking means more eval plumbing + entitlements. that bumps effort.
sarah (sales): reminder — long sales cycles but large deal sizes. even if reach is lower, deal sizes matter a lot for ARR impact. maybe scale Reach by potential contract size?
leo (eng): agreed — RICE is opinionated. let's add a 'deal-multiplier' column for sales-led purchases. quick update: Dedicated Reach 40 * 1.0 = 40, Private Reach 10 * 3.5 = 35. recompute RICE-ish moves these closer.
anya (prod): that suggests sequencing: invest enough in Private to unblock high-value pilots (minimal viable VPC + packaging) while prioritizing Dedicated infrastructure that drives self-serve growth. so outcome: two-track but with Dedicated sprint cadence higher.
deploy-bot: deployment window open: canary slot booked for Dedicated autoscale prototype on friday 10:00 UTC.
mike (ml): tactical ask: can we standardize the packaging for private now (docker + helm + doc skeleton) so timelines shrink? small infra spike up front pays later.
leo (eng): we can scope a 'private bootstrap' deliverable: config templates, KMS integration guide, audit log plumbing. estimate 2-3 sprints.
sarah (sales): i'll queue customer pilot agreements to sync with the bootstrap timeline. if we get one signed, bump priority.
anya (prod): action items: 1) leo — finalize RICE slide with deal-multiplier and risks by EOD. 2) mike — propose private bootstrap scope. 3) sarah — get written commitments for pilots. 4) engineering — greenlight Dedicated canary. quick sync tomorrow 11am PT.
leo (eng): noted. will drop slide and ping.
mike (ml): will post bootstrap sketch.
sarah (sales): i'll ping legal as well. :thumbsup:
